Port Newark / Doremus Avenue corridor — the canonical SalSon East Coast
flagship. salson.com publishes 888 Doremus Avenue, Newark NJ 07114 as its
Newark warehouse and container-yard address; the dossier describes a 55-acre,
multi-location campus with three yards and ~1M sq ft of Class-A warehouse
within a mile of Port Newark, operating 24/7 and processing ~2,000
containers/week. Satellite imagery matches exactly: a single very large
warehouse building (~1M sq ft footprint), extensive container/chassis yards
on multiple sides, an office building at the SE, and an active rail yard
along the north edge. Location locked with high confidence.

fieldNotes.truckGate: Main truck entrance off Doremus Ave at SW corner (~40.7010,-74.1326). Z20 satellite shows yellow-painted entry apron with painted STOP lines and a yellow OCR/portal gantry spanning the truck lanes; Street View confirms a steel portal gantry over the gated entry with chainlink fencing on both sides.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small structure(s) beside the yellow gantry visible in z20 satellite and Street View at the gate apron — consistent with a gate/check-in booth for a 24/7 port drayage operation tracking ~2,000 containers/week.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Yellow portal gantry at the gate is an OCR/inspection structure, then drivers proceed to interior container-yard / dock staging — effectively a two-stage gate-then-yard-control flow typical of PINC-managed container yards.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: 55-acre multi-building campus: ~1M sq ft warehouse plus container-yard parcels, an office building (SE), and a maintenance/secondary building cluster.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Loading docks along the south face of the main warehouse; numerous trailers backed in. 50+ band; estimate ~70 doors.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large container/chassis drop yards on south and north sides — z20 imagery shows dense rows of multicolored containers and trailers, well into the 50+ band; capacity ~600 trailers/containers.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active multi-track rail yard runs along the north edge of the property; rail tank/box cars and a siding adjacent to the campus.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Gate sits directly on Doremus Ave, a narrow two-lane city street; a truck queue at the gate would stack onto the public road.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron with a multi-lane painted approach under the gantry; physical room exists to designate an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified from overhead imagery; left uncertain.
